entry.title: New: dsh-office-plugin
entry.summary: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards. Exact install spec: github:geguanming/dsh-office-plugin. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
